Name: The New Wave
Notes: 1st song by Daft Punk; from "The New Wave" EP.

Name: Assault
Notes: 1st Daft Punk B-Side, not released on any other compilation/album since.

Name: Alive [V1]
Notes: Dubbed as "The New Wave Final Mix", close to the Homework version. Contains uncredited sample of "Electric Chair" by Prince.

Name:
Alive
(eDEN Extended Mix)
Notes: Includes a different intro and outro. Part of a cancelled compilation for the final issue of eDEN fanzine.

Name: Drive
Notes: Demo track given to SOMA Records. Originally intended to be a B-Side for Rollin' & Scratchin', before the record label pushed in favor of Da Funk. Included in the 2011 compilation "20 Years" from the label.

Name: Rollin' & Scratchin' [V1]
Notes: B-Side from the "Da Funk" Soma Single. It ends slightly differently than the Homework version.

Name:
The Chemical Brothers - Life Is Sweet
(Daft Punk Remix)

The Micronauts - Get Funky Get Down
(Daft Punk Remix)

ß Wax
(ft. DJ Kevin)
Notes: Released as part of the compilation "Two Years Together", a gift for suscribers to Coda Magazine.

Name: Da Funk 2
Notes: Existence confirmed by Daft Punk in an interview, considered as a B-Side of Da Funk. Discarded in favor to Rollin & Scratchin'.

Name:
Rollin' & Scratchin'
(Radio Edit)
Notes: Part of the "Rave Zone Montini, Volume 4" compilation CD.

Name:
Ian Pooley - Chord Memory
(Daft Punk Mix)
Notes: Later included in the "Musiqué Vol.1 1993-2005" compilation.

Name:
Part One
(as Indo Silver Club)
Notes: Released without credits. Contains a sample of "Hot Shot" by Karen Young. Part Two will become the original Indo Silver Club for the Homework album.

Name:
Gabrielle - Forget About the World
(Daft Punk 'Don't Forget About The World' Mix)
Notes: Later included in the "Musiqué Vol.1 1993-2005" compilation.

Name:
Indo Silver Club
(Daft Punk Remix)
Notes: Mentioned in press releases of the original Indo Silver Club, but never released.

Name:
Musique
(Version Longue)
Notes: Part of the compilation "Source Lab2". Released under the Roulé label, before the Virgin Records release of the single Da Funk.

Name: Musique
Notes: Released as a B-Side of the re-release of Da Funk. Later included in the "Musiqué Vol.1 1993-2005" compilation.

Name: Short Circuit [V1]
Notes: Played during the Daftendirektour concerts. It can be heard on the Alive 1997 album.

Name: Pulsar
Notes: Played during the Daftendirektour concerts. It can be heard on the Alive 1997 album and the "Rollin' & Scratchin'" music video.

Name:
Mansun - Taxloss
(Daft Punk Remix)
Notes: Mentioned in the Mansun biography in the 'Closed for Business' box set. Daft Punk sent in a remix for Taxloss, but it was never used

Name:
Teachers
(Extended)
Notes: Extended version released in the "Around the World" maxi single. Later included in the digital version of the "Homework Remixes" compilation.

Name:
Revolution 909
(Acapella)
Notes: Released as a B-Side of Revolution 909. Later included in the "Homework Remixes" compilation.

Name:
Scott Grooves - Mothership Reconnection
(Daft Punk Remix)
Notes: Originally a B-Side for the maxi-single in 1998, and re-released as his own single in August 1999. Later included in the "Musiqué Vol.1 1993-2005" compilation.

Name: One More Time [V1]
Notes: Thomas revealed that One More Time was "mixed and finished" in 1998. It's unknown if the song received changes before it's release as a single.

Name:
One More Time
(Club Mix)
Notes: Extended version of "One More Time", with extra vocals and effects after the 5:20 minutes of the original release.

Name:
One More Time
(Super Radio Edit)
Notes: Released in the compilation "One More Virgin - Tracks For Celebration Of New Century". Shorter than the original Radio Edit, with small sound effects added.

Name: Aerodynamite
Notes: B-Side for "Aerodynamic" single. Later included in "Daft Club" remix album.

Name:
Aerodynamic
(Daft Punk Remix)
Notes: Released exclusively on the Daft Club music service. Later included in "Daft Club" remix album. Contains samples from "One More Time".

Name: Ouverture
Notes: Background music for the Daft Club web service. Later included in "Daft Club" remix album.

Name:
Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger
(Acapella)
Notes: Daft Punk isolated vocals from HBFS. Available on the Daft Club web service.

Name:
Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger
(Instrumental)
Notes: Includes a longer introduction and slightly different reverbs. Available on the Daft Club web service.

Name: Digital Dub
Notes: Instrumental extended version, B-Side for "Digital Love" single.

Name: Britney Spears Collaboration
Notes: An unreleased collaboration between Daft Punk and Britney Spears potentially recorded between 2002-2003. Allegedly for Spears' 4th album In the Zone. It was never produced, according to a 2007 Guy-Man interview, but sources conflict.

Name: Gorillaz Collaboration
Notes: Damon Albarn said in 2002 that he was in conversations with Daft Punk for a project. Not confirmed if it was even produced.

Name: George Michael Demos
Notes: According to songwriter James Jackman, Daft Punk sent George Michael "a catalogue of demos to potentially write around". Those demos remained in George's archives. A demo version of Robot Rock was in that package.

Name:
Aerodynamic
(5555 credits Remix)
Notes: Remix used as a credits song for Interstella 5555. Mixed different than other versions of the song.

Name:
Franz Ferdinand - Take Me Out
(Daft Punk Remix)

Teriyaki Boyz - Heartbreaker
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Part of the album "Beef or Chicken". Includes samples from the song "Human After All".

Name:
Robot Rock
(Daft Punk's Maximum Overdrive Mix)
Notes: Originally released in the "Robot Rock" single. Later included in "Human After All: Remixes" album.

Name: Human After All Medley
Notes: Digital exclusive medley. Mix of all the songs on Human After All. Each song change is progressed by a snippet of On/Off.

Name: "Demo Track"
Notes: A bunch of separated sounds for a remix contest, but also discarded material from the Human After All sessions.

Name: Around the World / Technologic
Notes: A small portion of the 2006 Coachella performance that was removed during the 2007 shows and didn't make it onto the "Alive 2007" album. It was replaced with Burnin' and Phoenix.

Name: Aura Rock
Notes: Played during the Alive 2006/07 tour. It can be heard in "Too Long / Steam Machine" on the Alive 2007 album.

Name: medley.mp3
Notes: Background music for the Musiqué Vol.I official website. Includes parts of the songs available in the compilation.

Name: Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger (Alive 2007)
Notes: Single for the Alive 2007 release. Includes parts of "Television Rules the Nation / Crescendolls" and "Around the World / Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger".

Name: 4th Album demos
Notes: In 2013, both Daft Punk members confirmed to Rolling Stone that they recorded material for a new album after the Alive 2007 tour. However, those demos we're discarded. "The duo were dissatisfied with early demos that leaned heavily on electronic equipment, feeling like they were operating on “autopilot,” Thomas says". It is unknown how many of these sessions ended up in Random Access Memories.

Name:
Computerized
(ft. Jay-Z)
Notes: Produced at some point in 2010. Mitchell Leib, President of Music and Soundtracks for Walt Disney Records, convinced Daft Punk to create a "conventional credits song" with rapper Jay-Z. It was discarded and replaced with "TRON Legacy (End Titles)". The song was leaked in 2014.

Name:
N.E.R.D. - Hypnotize U
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: For "Nothing", 4th album of N.E.R.D.. Also written by Daft Punk.

Name: ENCOM Part I
Notes: From the "Tron Legacy OST" European Special Edition. Later included in the Collectors Digital EP and "TRON Legacy - The Complete Edition".

Name: ENCOM Part II
Notes: From the "Tron Legacy OST" European Special Edition. Later included in the Collectors Digital EP and "TRON Legacy - The Complete Edition".

Name: Round One
Notes: From the "Tron Legacy OST" European Special Edition. Later included in the Collectors Digital EP and "TRON Legacy - The Complete Edition".

Name: Castor
Notes: From the "Tron Legacy OST" European Special Edition. Later included in the Traslucence EP, Collectors Digital EP and "TRON Legacy - The Complete Edition".

Name: Reflections
Notes: From the "Tron Legacy OST" European Special Edition. Later included in the Collectors Digital EP and "TRON Legacy - The Complete Edition".

Name: Father and Son
Notes: From the "Tron Legacy OST"  iTunes edition. Later included in "TRON Legacy - The Complete Edition".

Name: Outlands, Part II
Notes: From the "Tron Legacy OST"  iTunes edition. Later included in "TRON Legacy - The Complete Edition".

Name: Sea of Simulation
Notes: From the "Tron Legacy OST"  Amazon MP3 edition. Later included in the Collectors Digital EP and "TRON Legacy - The Complete Edition".

Name: Sunrise Prelude
Notes: From the "Tron Legacy OST"  Nokia OVI Music Store edition. Later included in the Collectors Digital EP and "TRON Legacy - The Complete Edition".

Name: Tron Legacy Full Score
Notes: The "Tron Legacy" album doesn't have the full movie score. Some of the songs are barely different from the commercial release. In 2011, user "Metrotokyo" released a score version using isolated parts of the sound from the movie.

Name:
GL
(Early Take)
Notes: Probably recorded in the firsts sessions of RAM. Later included in "Random Access Memories 10th Anniversary Edition".

Name:
LYTD
(Vocoder Tests)
Notes: Probably recorded in the firsts sessions of RAM. Later included in "Random Access Memories 10th Anniversary Edition".

Name:
GLBTM
(Studio Outtakes)
Notes: Probably recorded in the firsts sessions of RAM. Later included in "Random Access Memories 10th Anniversary Edition".

Name: Horizon Ouverture
Notes: Later included in "Random Access Memories 10th Anniversary Edition".

Name: The Writing of Fragments of Time
Notes: 8 minutes recorded when Todd Edwards and Daft Punk created the lyrics of "Fragments of Time". Edited by Florian Lagatta. Included in "Random Access Memories 10th Anniversary Edition".

Name: The Giorgio Moroder Interview
Notes: The full Giorgio Moroder interview used in "Giorgio by Moroder". The conversation was included in the Deluxe Edition of RAM.

Name: Prime
Notes: Part of the RAM sessions. A 2012 unfinished version was included in "Random Access Memories 10th Anniversary Edition".

Name: Infinity Repeating
Notes: In 2014, Julian Casablancas teased a second collaboration with Daft Punk. The song doesn't have an official release until 2023, when a 2013 demo was included in "Random Access Memories 10th Anniversary Edition".

Name:
Kanye West - On Site [On Sight V1]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: First registered session between Daft Punk and Kanye West, originally for the unreleased "Thank God for the Drugs" album. Version with a pitched-down instrumental with alternate production, and freestyle vocals. This version was also played at the YZY SZN 10 casting.

Name:
Kanye West - Battucada [I Am a God V1]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Originally for the unreleased "Thank God for the Drugs" album. Kanye stated in an interview that he wrote and recorded a demo with Daft Punk after an incident at the Paris Fashion Week in 2012.

Name:
Kanye West - I Am God [I Am a God V2]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Slightly edited version of the original demo.

Name:
Kanye West - Leafy
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Originally for the unreleased "Thank God for the Drugs" album. Freestyle recorded in the same session as "I Am A God".

Name:
Kanye West - Tangerine Dream [Fall Out Of Heaven V1]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Originally for the unreleased "Thank God for the Drugs" album. Original reference over the Tangerine Dream sample for what would become "Can't Get Over Me". Samples "Hyperborea" by Tangerine Dream.

Name:
Kanye West - Chamber [Send it Up V1]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Original version of the "Send It Up" beat with just drums.

Name:
Kanye West - I Am a God [V3]
(ft. Elon Rutberg) (prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Version that adds elements from the Cruel Summer scrap "Espresso" to the song's intro and outro.Travis Scott takes the co-production of I Am a God in January 2013. It's unknown if Daft Punk was directly part of later sessions of the song.

Name:
Kanye West - Black Skinhead [V1]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Originally for the unreleased "Thank God for the Drugs" album. Earliest known version from December 2012. Not too different from later versions. Contains mumble vocals and a longer intro compared to post-Jan 2013 versions.

Name:
Kanye West - Black Skinhead [V2]
(ft. Bankulli) (prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Originally for the unreleased "Thank God for the Drugs" album. Rapper Bankulli said he laid unused "background vocals". Not audio availabe.

Name: Kanye West Collaboration
Notes: User Pharaohxx (who orchestrated the Kanye leak from April 2025) noted Daft Punk was featured on a song, in addition to doing production work. No evidence of what this song was has surfaced, but almost every claim Pharaohxx made either was confirmed when the album released or has been since verified by leaks.

Name:
Kanye West - I Am a God [V5]
(ft. The Weeknd) (prod. Daft Punk & Travis Scott)
Notes: Produced for "Yeezus". Has a seperate intro done by The Weeknd. Samples "I'm A Fool To Want You" by Billie Holiday. First known contact between Daft Punk and The Weeknd, before their 2016 songs. However, it's unknown if Daft Punk was directly part of this session.

Name:
Kanye West - Black Skinhead [V3]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: From this point, "Thank God for the Drugs" becames "Yeezus". Very similar to the December 2012 version, but with an outro sampling "Queens Will Play" by Black Mountain as well the unused track "Sweat On My Face" from Record4Hype. It's unknown if Daft Punk was directly part of this session.

Name:
Kanye West - Can't Get Over Me [Fall Out Of Heaven V4]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Produced for "Yeezus". Identical to the previous versions, but drums were removed, leaving only those that were already in the sample

Name:
Kanye West - Can't Get Over Me [Fall Out Of Heaven V5]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Produced for "Yeezus". Sessions for this version can be found in the leaked session folder.

Name:
Kanye West - Black Skinhead [V4]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Produced for "Yeezus". Filename shown by a trusted source douring big kanye leak from April 2025. Version made prior to Gesaffelstein's contributions.

Name:
Kanye West - Black Skinhead [V5]
(prod. Daft Punk & Gesaffelstein)
Notes: Produced for "Yeezus". Has mumble, minor production differencies, and Kanye growling in the background. Ends with 1:05 of open. It's unknown if Daft Punk was directly part of later sessions of the song.

Name:
Kanye West - Can't Get Over Me [Fall Out Of Heaven V7]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Produced for "Yeezus". Sessions for this version can be found in the leaked session folder, but there is no audio available.

Name: Horizon
Notes: Japanese Bonus Track in RAM. Later included in "Random Access Memories 10th Anniversary Edition" worldwide.

Name:
Kanye West - On Sight
(Co-prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Part of the album "Yeezus".

Name:
Kanye West - Black Skinhead
(Co-prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Part of the album "Yeezus".

Name:
Kanye West - I Am a God
(Co-prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Part of the album "Yeezus".

Name:
Kanye West - Send It Up
(Co-prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Part of the album "Yeezus".

Name:
Kanye West - Black Skinhead [iTunes]
(Co-prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Apple Music version of "Black Skinhead" which features more distorted vocals on the opening line of the song.

Name:
Kanye West - Send it Up [iTunes]
(Co-prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Apple Music version of "Send It Up" which cuts the instrumental out for the lines at the 1:30 mark

Name:
Junior Kimbrough - I Gotta Try You Girl
(Daft Punk Edit)
Notes: Soundtrack for the Yves Saint Laurent Spring 2013 Paris Fashion Week show. Released in 2017 as a "Record Store Day" single by Fat Possum Records. The commercial release comes from a YouTube re-upload.

Name:
Pharrell Williams - Gust of Wind
(ft. Daft Punk)
Notes: For "G I R L", 2nd solo album by Pharrell Williams. Also written by Daft Punk.

Name:
The Weeknd - I Feel It Coming [V1]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Snippet of a Eric Chedeville studio session from March 2014, where the idea for the "I Feel It Coming" beat came from. Most likely at the time intended for their album following 'Random Access Memories'.

Name: Todd Edwards & Daft Punk project
Notes: In 2018, Todd Edwards revealed that he was working on a vocal album with Daft Punk since 2014. It is unknown if any songs were completed before the end of Daft Punk.

Name:
The Weeknd - I Feel It Coming [V2]
(prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Features a slightly different mix and features Daft Punk on both hooks instead of just the last one. Leaked in November 2016.

Name:
Kanye West - Over [V14]
(feat. Bon Iver & The-Dream) (prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Mixed for the unreleased albums "Yeezus 2" and "SWISH". Filename seen in a folder of August 2015 tracks. Cut-down version of "Can't Get Over Me" with some production elements removed, less Bon Iver vocals, and re-recorded verses from Kanye, with some alternate lyrics. Still contains mumble. While Daft Punk is credited as producers, it is unknown if they worked directly on this version.

Name:
The Weeknd - Starboy
(ft. Daft Punk)
Notes: Also produced by Daft Punk. 1st single from the album "Starboy" by The Weeknd.

Name:
The Weeknd - I Feel it Coming
(ft. Daft Punk)
Notes: Also produced by Daft Punk. 3rd single from the album "Starboy" by The Weeknd.

Name:
Parcels - Overnight
(Prod. Daft Punk)
Notes: Final song with Daft Punk credited.

Name: 5th album demos
Notes: In a 2024 interview, drummer Quinn Smith (who worked in RAM) revealed that Daft Punk we're in studio in 2018 for a possible 5th album. The idea was discarded after early sessions.

Name:
Touch
(2021 Epilogue)
Notes: Remix used in the "Epilogue" video. Later included in "Random Access Memories 10th Anniversary Edition".
